password-generator.name: Password Generator
password-generator.description: Generate cryptographically strong passwords and passphrases on your device.

tips.1: Passphrases are easier to type on phones and just as strong at 5+ words.
tips.2: Aim for at least 80 bits of entropy for anything important.
tips.3: Avoid-ambiguous mode helps when someone has to read the password aloud.
